summary: Phases 1-6 complete and committed (712dce72). Phase 5's deadness-proof gate fired: false_at kept, not deleted. Phase 6 classified all bimodal/oracle failures under heavy external contention; 2 confirmed genuine solve-time regressions fixed forward (max_time 15->30); 2 failures remain explicitly unclassified. Phase 7's exhaustive re-derivation (~60-90 min) was launched in the background (pid varies, see continuation_context) despite the machine failing its idle pre-flight check (persistent external Lean build, load avg 4.5-11.2) -- not yet complete at return time. Phases 8-9 depend on Phase 7's output and were not started.

blockers.description: Phase 7's exhaustive complexity<=5 re-derivation scan (python oracle/scan_runner.py --timeout-ms 10000 --out-dir specs/139_.../baselines/derivation-run/) was launched in the background but had not written its SCAN_COMPLETE marker as of this dispatch's return. It must run to completion (poll for specs/139_fix_z3_quantifier_variable_shadowing_in_temporal_operators/baselines/derivation-run/SCAN_COMPLETE, never PID liveness) before Phase 8 (manifest rebuild) or Phase 9 (final audit) can proceed. The machine failed its idle pre-flight check when the scan was launched (a persistent, repeatedly-restarting external `lean lake build` process sustaining 500-1300% CPU); if the completed run's conclusive_count is implausibly low (below ~95, the plan's own stated re-run floor), re-run on an idle machine per the plan's Hard Constraint section rather than baking a degraded baseline into Phase 8.

Two Phase 6 oracle gating-suite failures (test_all_sat_task_relation_ternary, test_all_sat_results_have_complete_output) remain explicitly unclassified -- not verified as environmental or as regressions. Re-run in isolation (ideally on an idle machine) and apply the same PRE_FIX_SHA-comparison methodology used for the other Phase 6 findings before concluding either way.

decisions_made: Phase 2 AMENDMENT: z3.FreshInt causes a severe MBQI performance regression; replaced with _fresh_bound_int() (counter-suffixed z3.Int) at all 14 sites -- same soundness guarantee, no regression.

Phase 5 GATE FIRED: deadness proof found 7 non-zero false_at invocations, all from unit tests calling operator.false_at() directly (never from find_countermodel()). Per the plan's own contingency, this flips the default DELETE decision to keep-and-fix; no code change needed. Full analysis: evidence/phase5-deadness-proof.md.
Phase 6: bimodal package suite's 2 failures (BM_CM_1, BM_CM_4) reproduce identically against PRE_FIX_SHA under current contention -- classified environmental, not a regression.

Phase 6: oracle gating suite pass 2 (contention-free-by-design) timed out entirely at its 900s budget -- itself diagnostic of severe external contention (an unrelated repo's `lean lake build` sustaining 900-1300% CPU, load average 9.6-11.2, observed continuously for the ~90+ minutes of this dispatch).

Phase 6: confirmed 2 genuine (category-c) solve-time regressions (test_countermodel_bm_cm4_at_example_settings, test_regression_standard_pipeline[BM_CM_4]) via deterministic reproduction at low load plus a PRE_FIX_SHA scratch-swap comparison (post-fix consistently ~15.3s/timeout vs pre-fix consistently 4-6s); root cause is the same Z3 term-identity-simplification-shortcut loss already documented for Box(p)->Box(p) in Phase 2 -- confirmed via a 60s-budget run that the countermodel is still genuinely found (~24s), so this is a solve-time cost, not a correctness defect. Fixed forward per TESTING_GUIDE 8.6 by widening both tests' local max_time 15->30 (not a Hard-Constraint-pinned artifact); both confirmed green after.

Phase 6: test_spot_check_individual_countermodels (F9_until_implies_event unexpectedly SAT instead of expected None) investigated and found NOT a regression: PRE_FIX_SHA comparison showed all four candidate formulas (F4/F7/F9/F10) were already timing out pre-fix (never a confident 'valid' verdict), so this is 'previously undecided -> now decided', not 'previously correct -> now wrong'. The new decided answer's mathematical correctness was not independently re-derived -- flagged as a follow-up, not asserted either way.

Phase 6: time-boxed per explicit mid-dispatch direction -- 2 of the 9 pass-1 oracle failures (test_all_sat_task_relation_ternary, test_all_sat_results_have_complete_output) were left unclassified rather than pursuing further confirmation runs under sustained contention. Recorded as an open item, not asserted clean.

Phase 7: launched the exhaustive re-derivation despite the machine failing its idle pre-flight check, per explicit direction not to block on it. This is a recorded, non-silent deviation from the plan's pre-flight requirement; the plan's own conclusive_count sanity floor (~95) governs whether Phase 8 may trust this specific run's result or must trigger a re-run.
dead_ends: z3.FreshInt was tried first (per the plan) and found unusable in practice due to the MBQI regression -- documented in full in evidence/post-fix-measurements.md rather than silently discarded.
